rast hints and light/dark modes.
# dsh-colorlab
**EN** · 中文

A colour theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness chat UI. It ships Sublime Text's
**Mariana** palette

as its default preset, and adds a colour engine on top: 18
adjustable colour slots, 9 Markdown prose

roles, saved presets, live WCAG contrast
warnings and light/dark modes — all from a settings panel,
persisted to your profile.

> Process rows are colour-coded (green for tool calls, amber for summaries),
> headings and inline c

ode are tinted, and the surface sits on Mariana's
> cool blue-grey rather than pure black.
### Glass UI (opt-in)

With **Glass interface** on, the three columns become translucent panels over a
background layer — y

our Windows wallpaper, a generated gradient, or a procedural
topographic contour sheet. Blur is appl

ied once, to the background itself, so
every surface sees the same frosted world underneath; each la

yer paints only the
*difference* between its tier and the one below, so cards stay legibly above the
columns and the columns stay tinted with the theme instead of washing out.

> Screenshot: glass on over a wallpaper; title bar, sidebar and conversation
> read as one continuou

s sheet of tinted glass; the composer card is lifted out
> of the scroll flow, so streamed text clip

s cleanly at its top edge instead of
> sliding underneath.
### Background ground: glow / bands / blend

The generated-gradient background is a small compositor of its own. Pick **glow**
(soft coloured fog

, no edges), **bands** (angular colour strips) or **blend**
(both), then colour every element yourse

o edges), **bands** (angular colour strips) or **blend**
(both), then colour every element yourself:

- **Glow** — 2–6 light sources, each with its own colour, strength and X/Y
position, plus overall de

nsity (0–100%) and spread (40–140%).
- **Bands** — 2–6 strips, each its own colour, plus a cutting a

ngle anywhere
from 0° to 360° and an edge-softness slider (0 = hard cut).

> Screenshot: the generated gradient background in glow mode — several soft
> coloured lights compos
ited over the theme base, no wallpaper involved.
## What it changes

Mariana is the default colour scheme of Sublime Text 3.0 (2017) and Sublime
Text 4. Its background i

s a cool blue-grey (`#343D46`) rather than pure black,
and its foreground is a soft grey (`#D8DEE9`)

rather than pure white — which is
why it stays readable for long sessions on bright displays.
| Area | Effect |

| Surfaces / cards / sidebar / menus | `#343D46` / `#2F3841` / `#23292E` |
| Body / secondary / tert

iary text | `#D8DEE9` / `#A7ADBA` / `#8792A2` |
| Borders and dividers | low-opacity overlays of `#D

8DEE9` |
| Bubbles / input / code blocks | `#3B454F` / `#2E363F` |
| Status colours | success `#99C7

94`, error `#EC5F67`, warning `#F9AE58` |
| Code syntax highlighting | keywords `#C594C5`, strings `

#99C794`, functions `#5FB3B3`, numbers `#F9AE58`, comments `#8792A2` |
| Sidebar terminal | backgrou
nd and cursor follow the theme |
## Known limitations

- **Terminal ANSI 16 colours are not themed.** The host does not expose the
xterm ANSI palette as de

sign tokens and the plugin cannot reach the xterm
instance, so only the terminal background, foregro

und, cursor and selection
follow the theme.
- **Prose highlighting depends on a host class-name pref

ix.** It matches
`[class*="_markdown_"]`; the prefix comes from a host source filename and is
stable

across builds, but if the host **renames that CSS Module file** the
rule stops matching — prose fal

ls back to a single colour, without an error.
- **Prose highlighting does not cover half-parsed Mark

down.** During streaming
the DOM structure is the same so rules still apply, but an unclosed `**` is

not coloured while it is half-written.
- **Corner radii are untouched by default.** Fonts stay with

`dsh-font-probe`.
The optional **Hand-drawn shape** toggle does restyle corner radii and
shadows —

deliberately off by default, and it only ever touches named
surfaces (input card, dialogs, menus, co

de blocks, detected cards), never
a full-tree scan.
- **The light variant is not original Mariana.**

ply to both" mode is not glaring.
- **Custom colours only override the dark appearance.** There are

no custom
slots for light — deliberately, so colours picked against a dark background
do not become

invisible on a light one.
- **Presets live as a YAML string in your profile.** The 12-preset cap kee

ps
this bounded. If you hand-edit `cordis.patch.yml` and break the `presets`
field, the plugin safel

y treats it as "no presets" — nothing throws and
nothing is lost, the presets just stop showing unti

presets" — nothing throws and
nothing is lost, the presets just stop showing until you fix the YAML.
## 已知限制

- **终端 ANSI 16 色不变。** 宿主没有把 xterm 的 ANSI 调色板暴露成设计令牌，
插件也拿不到 xterm 实例，只能保证底色 / 前景 / 光标 / 选区跟随主题。
- **

正文高亮的选择器依赖宿主类名前缀。** 用 `[class*="_markdown_"]` 匹配，
前缀来自宿主源文件名，跨构建稳定；但宿主若**重命名那个 CSS Module 文件**，
规则会失

配 —— 表现是正文退回同色，不会报错。
- **正文高亮不覆盖流式渲染中的半截 Markdown。** DOM 结构相同所以规则照常命中，
但未闭合的 `**` 在半截状态下不会被着色。
- **默

认不改圆角与字体。** 字体是 `dsh-font-probe` 的职责；可选的「手绘造型」
开关会改圆角与投影 —— 刻意默认关，且只点名已知表面（输入卡/对话框/菜单/
代码块/检测到的卡片），不

做全树扫描。
- **浅色变体不是 Mariana 原版。** Mariana 本身只有深色版，浅色值是同色相提亮的
自制品，只为「深浅都套用」模式下不刺眼。
- **自定义配色只覆盖深色。** 浅色

没有对应槽位 —— 刻意的，避免把深色下挑的颜色
搬到浅色底上变成看不见的字。
- **配色方案存在 profile 的 YAML 字符串里。** 12 套上限是为了不让它无限膨胀。
如果手改 `co

rdis.patch.yml` 把 `presets` 写坏，插件会安全地当成「没有方案」，
不抛错也不丢数据，只是界面上看不到 —— 修好 YAML 即可恢复。
